The Chinese characters for Keith

As a transliteration, Keith is usually written 基思 (Jī sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

基

思

Origin and meaning

Keith comes from Scottish and means “wood, forest (of uncertain origin)”.
